pages.text: The Destruction Core is a specialized component used in devices that break or collect blocks and items from the world. It is essential for automation involving block breaking and collection.
Features:$(li)Used in Destructor devices$(li)Enables block breaking automation$(li)Required for automated mining$(li)Part of advanced collection systems
Usage:$(li)Craft Destructors for automation$(li)Enable automated block breaking$(li)Part of automated harvesting systems$(li)Used in mining automation
